*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboTwin 2.0 place_cans_plasticbox, standard-mode trajectory.
+
+Uses only RGB/depth camera observations, the provided camera calibration, and
+the measured end-effector/gripper state. Run with /opt/tools on PYTHONPATH.
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver
+
+
+CAM = "head_camera"
+TABLE_Z = 0.75
+Q_LEFT = None
+Q_RIGHT = None
+
+
+def world_point_from_depth(obs, cam, u, v):
+    """Back-project a small image patch using the service's CV calibration."""
+    depth = obs.depth[cam][0].astype(np.float32) * 0.001  # depth is mm
+    h, w = depth.shape
+    ui, vi = int(round(u)), int(round(v))
+    patch = depth[max(0, vi - 2):min(h, vi + 3), max(0, ui - 2):min(w, ui + 3)]
+    vals = patch[np.isfinite(patch) & (patch > 0.15) & (patch < 2.0)]
+    d = float(np.median(vals))
+    cal = obs.meta["cameras"][cam]
+    K = np.asarray(cal["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=np.float64)
+    T = np.eye(4, dtype=np.float64)
+    T[:3, :] = np.asarray(cal["extrinsic_cv"], dtype=np.float64)
+    p_cam = np.array([(u - K[0, 2]) * d / K[0, 0],
+                      (v - K[1, 2]) * d / K[1, 1], d, 1.0])
+    p_world = np.linalg.inv(T) @ p_cam
+    return p_world[:3]
+
+
+def ee_pose_now(obs):
+    p = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)
+    return p[14:28].copy()
+
+
+def run():
+    robot = Robot(timeout=600)
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    print("connected", spec["protocol"], spec["task_text"], flush=True)
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=(CAM, "front_camera"), include_depth=True, video="none")
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)
+    print("initial", {k: obs.meta.get(k) for k in ("step", "sim_time_s", "time_left_s")}, flush=True)
+    print("initial ee", now[14:28].tolist(), "grippers", now[36], now[43], flush=True)
+
+    # Pixel centers are selected from the head RGB view: left and right can.
+    # Their depth-backed points provide each can's x and visible center height.
+    left_surface = world_point_from_depth(obs, CAM, 80, 165)
+    right_surface = world_point_from_depth(obs, CAM, 307, 166)
+    cans = [left_surface.copy(), right_surface.copy()]
+    # The selected pixels lie on the camera-facing side of each can. Shift the
+    # grasp TCP half a can radius toward the table interior (+y) to center it.
+    cans = [(float(p[0]), float(p[1] + 0.025), float(np.clip(p[2] - 0.01, 0.79, 0.84))) for p in cans]
+    print("camera-derived can TCP targets", cans, flush=True)
+
+    # The inner floor is visible in the calibrated head depth image around
+    # x=[-.05,.05], y=[-.16,-.05]. Use two adjacent, upright slots.
+    slots = [(-0.025, -0.105, 0.815), (0.025, -0.105, 0.815)]
+
+    def get_latest():
+        return robot.get_obs(cameras=(CAM, "front_camera"), video="none")
+
+    def move(arm, xyz, grip, note):
+        nonlocal obs
+        current = ee_pose_now(obs)
+        left = current[:7].copy()
+        right = current[7:14].copy()
+        if arm == "left":
+            left[:3] = xyz
+            left[3:7] = Q_LEFT
+            lg, rg = grip, float(now_from(obs)[13])
+        else:
+            right[:3] = xyz
+            right[3:7] = Q_RIGHT
+            lg, rg = float(now_from(obs)[6]), grip
+        row = np.r_[left, lg, right, rg].astype(np.float32)
+        res = robot.submit("ee_pose", row, cameras=(CAM, "front_camera"), video="none", note=note)
+        plans = res.meta.get("plan")
+        print("action", note, "done", res.meta.get("done"), "plan", plans,
+              "sim", res.meta.get("sim_time_s"), "left", res.meta.get("time_left_s"), flush=True)
+        if res.done:
+            raise EpisodeOver(res.meta.get("reason") or "episode complete")
+        obs = get_latest()
+        return obs
+
+    def now_from(o):
+        return np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)
+
+    def process_can(arm, center, slot, slot_index):
+        nonlocal obs
+        x, y, z = center
+        sx, sy, sz = slot
+        # Keep the inactive arm at its measured pose. Approach with the existing
+        # downward table-facing orientation, then close around the can body.
+        approach_y = y - 0.12
+        move(arm, (x, approach_y, 0.98), 1.0, f"{arm} can {slot_index}: pregrasp")
+        move(arm, (x, approach_y, z), 1.0, f"{arm} can {slot_index}: lower to grasp")
+        move(arm, (x, approach_y, z), 0.0, f"{arm} can {slot_index}: close gripper")
+        obs = get_latest()
+        n = now_from(obs)
+        opening = float(n[36] if arm == "left" else n[43])
+        print("grasp opening", arm, opening, "(open is near 1; empty closed is near 0)", flush=True)
+        # Continue from the measured arm pose so object-dependent coupling does
+        # not accumulate target error.
+        move(arm, (x, approach_y, 0.99), 0.0, f"{arm} can {slot_index}: lift")
+        # Place above the inner floor, descend, then open while stationary.
+        slot_approach_y = sy - 0.12
+        move(arm, (sx, slot_approach_y, 0.99), 0.0, f"{arm} can {slot_index}: over box")
+        move(arm, (sx, slot_approach_y, sz), 0.0, f"{arm} can {slot_index}: lower into box")
+        move(arm, (sx, slot_approach_y, sz), 1.0, f"{arm} can {slot_index}: release")
+        move(arm, (sx, slot_approach_y, 0.99), 1.0, f"{arm} can {slot_index}: retreat")
+        obs = get_latest()
+        if obs.meta.get("done"):
+            print("episode ended", obs.meta.get("reason"), flush=True)
+            return True
+        return False
+
+    global Q_LEFT, Q_RIGHT
+    Q_LEFT = now[17:21].copy()
+    Q_RIGHT = now[24:28].copy()
+    # Each arm carries one can to a separate side-by-side position.
+    process_can("left", cans[0], slots[0], 1)
+    if obs.meta.get("done"):
+        return
+    process_can("right", cans[1], slots[1], 2)
+    print("final", {k: obs.meta.get(k) for k in ("step", "sim_time_s", "time_left_s", "done", "reason")}, flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        run()
+    except EpisodeOver as e:
+        print("episode over:", e, flush=True)
